errata.was: AI-assisted (substrate). Written under the heteronyms Johannes Sigil and Damascus Dancings (legal author Lee Sharks). Composed by Claude (Anthropic, Claude Opus 5.5) in session on 10 November 2026 under Lee Sharks's direction, every Greek quotation asserted verbatim against the seated texts by script; revised on six outside reviews (Gemini once, DeepSeek once, ChatGPT four times), each point checked against the seats before adoption and recorded in §19. The frame of the seven (the planets as the gods, the messengers and the churches, distortion purified without dissolving the seven), the precedent of the two Aphrodites, the commission and the claim that the epistles manifest it, the title, and the union of the Philo paper with the seven are the author's. The Crimson Hexagonal Archive is credited as a contributor: the work is built from its deposits, seatings, protocols and registries.
